reset_protocol.history_rule: For case index i, instantiate a fresh environment; replay reset + init state + 10 dummy waits for each anchor j<i, then seed/reset/set target state and wait 10. No policy calls in warmup. This preserves the old five-anchor initial scenes and is independent of subset/queue/variant order.
reset_protocol.scope_note: Common reproducible scene definitions across conditions; not a claim of byte-identical official 50-trial sequential reset semantics.

analysis.units: 269 paired roots nested in 200 episodes and 10 tasks; early/late cohorts reported separately
metrics: paired successes and losses vs continue
additional policy calls and inference seconds
analysis.intervals: Exploratory task-cluster bootstrap; no multiplicity-adjusted or confirmation claim. Roots and branches are not independent episodes.
analysis.oracle: Any-candidate success is only an offline feasibility upper bound, never a deployed selector score.
analysis.feasibility_gate: At least 8 distinct originally failed episodes with A and B both failing and at least one fixed candidate succeeding, and all new model/physics reconstruction audits passed.
analysis.noise_limit: One same-seed repeat B for each fixed A; report disagreements and sensitivity, no claim of zero stochastic variance.

prior_resource_accounting.note: Admission/report timestamp to completion file mtime, includes CPU and I/O; excludes user decision wait and is not pure GPU compute.

model_replay: all actual calls on all five branches; same original 1e-6 action tolerance
physics_replay: all 538 new A/B suffixes, actual recorded actions; 1e-7 physics, 1e-6 proprioception, exact goal and terminal step
robust_rescue_rule: original baseline fail AND continue_a fail AND continue_b fail AND any fixed candidate success, unique episode count
root_acquisition: Verified historical root observation when available; otherwise a single pre-action measurement, identical across all five methods. Never outcome-selected or repeatedly sampled.
execution_repair: Bounded retry only when du reports a disappeared atomic JSON temporary. Never use partial du counts; other disk errors still fail. Fully recorded interrupted rollout is audited, not re-simulated.
resumption_rule: Reuse only immutable hash-bound artifacts from this approved paired round. Completed historical strict-round outcomes are never allowed.
